gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.
happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: I look forward to ___ you at the reunion.
gaps.explanation: 'To' is a preposition here, so the gerund follows.

gaps.sentence: You'd better ___ a taxi or you'll miss the plane.
gaps.explanation: had better takes the bare infinitive: you'd better take.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
